name: layaview
description: A local-first live visualizer for Laya decision-model calls, forked from Jeview.

scripts.check:pages: node --check ui/app.js && node --check demo/game.js && node --check demo/support-desk.js
scripts.llms: node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { llmsText } from './src/jeview.ts'; writeFileSync('llms.txt', llmsText('http://127.0.0.1:4777'));"
